prose: OpenAI says GPT-6 in ChatGPT's Chat tab runs on GPT-6 Sol for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users, and on GPT-6 Luna for Free and Go users. GPT-6 with Intelligent UI rolls out globally to the paid tiers on the day of the post and reaches Free and Go starting the next day.

This clarifies the earlier announcement of GPT-6 for everyone: the model differs by tier, not just the features. The source is a post on X, summarized via Techmeme, so only the excerpted facts are available.
highlights: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise get GPT-6 Sol
Free and Go get GPT-6 Luna
Intelligent UI rolls out to paid tiers first
Free and Go users follow the next day
Source is an OpenAI post on X, via Techmeme
